play(bytes32).notice: Anyone can play. The coin goes straight into Quarters with this door as the player of record; the door remembers who you are and your status.

pullOwed().notice: If Quarters couldn't deliver a win to this door, it holds it as owed; anyone can pull it here so it can be settled.

refill().notice: Top the live jackpot back up to REFILL_TO from the reserve. Anyone can call it; it only ever moves reserve into the pool.

retire().notice: The Quarters authority can close this door for a new one. The reserve goes back into the Bounty pool at once. A jackpot that has arrived but isn't settled yet stays for its winner (settle still works after retirement); a day later anyone can sweep whatever is left to the pool.

settle(bytes32,uint256).notice: Called by the Quarters verifier (the same key that wrote the score) once a door seat's winning run has paid out: `received` is the pool Quarters paid for that win. Pays the winner by status, keeps the rest, refills.

sweep().notice: After a retired door has had a day for its last settlements, anything still unsettled (late direct sends, dust) goes back into the pool.

unsettled().notice: The money this door holds that isn't the reserve or owed to someone: a jackpot that has arrived and not been settled yet.
